wire: cleanup report -> largest.largest_file -> the 'largest file' line of the report

criteria.text: for a root (a str or os.PathLike) that names an existing directory, and a tree under it at most 100 levels deep in which every path is shorter than 1024 bytes, largest_file(root) returns (path relative to root, size in bytes) of the largest directory entry under root that is a regular file, on a tie the one whose path sorts first as a str, None if there is none, or raises OSError if it cannot determine which entry that is
symbolic links under root are neither followed nor counted
